propositions: Structurally divergent LLM responses can normalize to empty verification results that must not produce valid pass or empty review outcomes
Tolerant Pydantic parsing in verify_models.py can produce empty models from unexpected provider/model output variations

Two distinct paths produce semantically empty verifications: raw-empty (no list returned) and malformed-to-empty (non-empty list with all items dropped by reshape), both already routed to indeterminate by decide.pass3_decide

verify_findings kernel function implements outcome_counts telemetry buckets (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) with unit test coverage, but plan_review_decide and code_review_decide workflows build and call reshape_verifications inline without calling verify_findings, leaving production telemetry wiring incomplete
Resilient parsing, bounded retries, and provider-independent self-healing must be preserved while guaranteeing semantically empty responses never produce valid review decisions
